name: Local-First Verification CLI
summary: Build a stack-aware, read-only CLI that classifies verified facts, warnings, failures, skipped checks, and unverified production claims before developers trust AI-generated changes.
problem: Static checks and local command success can be mistaken for production readiness, while skipped or unavailable evidence is often collapsed into false confidence.
requirements: Dedicated evidence output path when needed
boundaries: Read-only by design must be enforced
Repository scan is not a security audit
